issue.subject: OSD crash during deep scrub with BlueStore
issue.description:
OSD.5 crashes during deep scrub with the following stacktrace:

#0 0x00007f1234 in ceph_abort()
#1 0x00007f1235 in BlueStore::_do_read()

ceph osd deep-scrub osd.5

HEALTH_WARN too many PGs per OSD

osd_deep_scrub_interval = 604800

2024-10-15T10:30:00.123456 7f1234 -1 osd.5 shutting down

journals.notes: I can reproduce this on reef 18.2.4. Looks like a race in BlueStore::_do_read.
Fixed by PR #56789. The issue was a missing lock acquisition.
